title.en: Location fallback and the user’s latest choice
title.zh: 天气功能复盘：定位失败后，如何尊重用户的选择？

summary.en: Label device and network estimates, preserve manual city selection and test searches that finish out of order.
summary.zh: 标明设备定位与网络估算，保留手动选城的优先级，并检查乱序返回的搜索结果。

basis.en: Reviewed shared/weather.ts and Web/mobile weather components at membership revision ef8c6cd. Twelve mocked scenarios were rerun; live geolocation providers were not called in these checks.
basis.zh: 核对会员系统版本 ef8c6cd 的 shared/weather.ts 与 Web／移动天气组件；复跑 12 个模拟场景，未在这些检查中调用真实定位服务。

title.en: Location is one way to choose a city
title.zh: 定位只是选城的一种入口

paragraphs.en: The interface supports shortcuts, city search and location. When the user manually selects a city while GPS is pending, that selection should remain authoritative. load() increments locationGeneration, so a late device or network result cannot replace the new city.
paragraphs.zh: 界面提供常用城市、城市搜索和定位。当 GPS 尚未返回时，用户已经手动选城，后到的定位结果不应再替换选择。load() 会递增 locationGeneration，让旧设备或网络定位结果失效。

paragraphs.en: Keeping an old temperature on screen while changing the city can imply that the temperature belongs to the new location. The current load path clears weather data first and shows a loading state, then renders the returned result.
paragraphs.zh: 切换城市时继续展示旧温度，容易让读者误以为它属于新地点。当前加载流程会先清空天气结果并显示加载状态，再渲染返回的数据。

title.zh: 让位置来源与精度可见

paragraphs.en: The reviewed logic accepts finite device coordinates within geographic ranges and device accuracy no worse than 5,000 metres. Otherwise it tries a network estimate. This is a project threshold for nearby weather, not a general rule for attendance, delivery or emergency services.
paragraphs.zh: 当前逻辑要求设备经纬度为有效范围内的有限数值，且精度误差不超过 5,000 米，否则尝试网络估算。这是附近天气的项目阈值，不适合直接沿用到签到、配送或应急场景。

paragraphs.en: Network location can follow a VPN exit or a carrier address. The UI labels it as an estimate, identifies ipwho.is and leaves manual city selection available. Location success and weather-data success are separate outcomes: locate() starts load() without awaiting the weather request.
paragraphs.zh: 网络位置可能跟随 VPN 出口或运营商地址。界面标明“网络估算”和 ipwho.is，并保留手动选城。定位成功与天气获取成功也应分开：locate() 启动 load() 时没有等待天气请求完成。

title.en: Handle typing before the response returns
title.zh: 用户继续输入时，旧搜索已经失效

paragraphs.en: The search watcher invalidates old results synchronously as the query changes. find() checks a separate search generation before writing results, errors or loading state. This covers the case where a user types a new term but has not submitted the next search yet.
paragraphs.zh: 搜索输入变化时，同步监听会立即使旧结果失效。find() 在写结果、错误和加载状态前检查独立的 searchGeneration，因此用户改了词、尚未再次点击搜索时，旧响应也不会突然出现。

paragraphs.en: The 12 passing fixtures cover reversed response order, short queries, typing during a request, search failure, permission or accuracy fallback, device versus network choice, late positioning after manual selection, location failure and unmount. They validate application choices with mocked inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 本次 12 个通过场景涉及乱序返回、短词、等待期间改词、搜索失败、授权或精度回退、设备／网络选择、手动选城后的迟到定位、定位失败及卸载。它们使用模拟输入验证应用逻辑。

title.en: Next checks need the real platforms
title.zh: 下一轮应放到真实终端上

paragraphs.en: The remaining work is to observe timeouts and permission changes on actual devices, validate the server response shape, and show data age when the provider is slow. A typed return value alone does not guarantee a current observation or a valid daily forecast array.
paragraphs.zh: 后续还需在真实设备上观察超时和权限变化，校验服务端响应结构，并在供应方延迟时说明数据时间。标注返回类型不能保证当前观测及时，也不能保证日预测数组完整。
